Gorki Apartments
Your second home in the heart of Berlin
Our apartments are your temporary home. Because at Gorki you are not just a guest - here you will become a real Berliner. Complete with bell plate and own mailbox. Generously cut and furnished with great attention to detail, the apartments exude creative flair and timeless elegance. Thanks to the careful restoration of the building, they are also completely geared towards modern living - the perfect retreat after a day (or night) in the capital. Whatever brings you to Berlin - in Gorki Apartments you live as stylish and comfortable as in a boutique hotel and enjoy the privacy and individuality of a fully equipped luxury residence. Located in a Wilhelminian style building between the Hackesche Höfe and Prenzlauer Berg, the Gorki is an ideal starting point for all activities - whether sightseeing, shopping or nightlife.

Families / Family rooms
Your family stay in the heart of Berlin
Welcome to Gorki Apartments, where luxurious living meets family-friendly comfort! Our two spacious and stylishly furnished penthouses, available for bookings starting from 2 nights, are perfect for a family stay in the German capital.
Our Penthouse 1 features three bedrooms and covers 200m2 while Penthouse 2 offers two bedrooms ans spans 180m2. Both apartments provide ample space for your family to move around freely and comfortably. Additionally, there's plenty of room for cribs, ensuring that every family members feels at home. For your family vacation in Berlin, we offer modern amenities, comfort and personalized service to make sure you and your family have everything you need!
Our penthouses are fully equipped to meet the needs of your family for a pleasant and stress-free stay :
Fully equipped kitchen : Each kitchen includes a ceramic cooktop, an oven, a fridge with freezer, a dishwasher, a toaster, a Nespresso coffee machine, a kettle and a KitchenAid. On request, we can also provide a microwave or a baby chair. A large dining table offers plenty of space for family meals.
Grocery shopping service : In addition to daily cleaning and 24/7 concierge service, we offer a grocery shopping service. Just send us your shopping list, and we'll ensure your fridge is well-stocked upon your arrival.
Laundry facilities : Each penthouse is equipped with a washing machine, a tumble dryer, an iron and an ironing board.
Thanks to a newly installed connecting door, we can now offer spacious family rooms across three floors. These consist of two Category 3 apartments, which can be transformed into a private, interconnected living area through the elegant double door. This way, families or friends can enjoy even more comfort and privacy – right in the heart of Berlin.
Entertainment : Every bedroom as well as the living room are equipped with a TV with Bang & Olufsen speakers, so the whole family can enjoy their favorite shows.
Comfort and well-being : Both penthouses are air-conditioned and feature organic care products from Be My Friend, ensuring the highest level of comfort.
Nearby essentials : In the vicinity of Gorki Apartments, you'll find playgrounds, a park, supermarkets and a pharmacy.

The story of Gorki Apartments
The Gorki Apartments tell a story deeply intertwined with Berlin's history. Instead of a traditional lobby, guests are welcomed by a stylish, 24-hour reception that feels like a private residence and is accessible through a charming, green courtyard.
The building housing the Gorki Apartments dates back to the early 20th century. The rear building once hosted an automotive radiator workshop until the 1950s, a detail still visible in the faded lettering on the wall. The structure survived World War II with minimal damage but fell into disrepair after the construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961. It wasn’t until nearly 50 years later that the current owners acquired the building and meticulously restored it, allowing it to shine in new splendor once more.
After five years of restoration and construction, the Gorki opened in November 2013.
In collaboration with the architectural firm Fuchshuber & Partner, French-German architect Sandra Pauquet, together with Kim Wang and team, breathed new life into the historic building. The design of the Gorki Apartments pays homage to typical Berlin apartments, featuring exposed walls, high ceilings, original stucco details, and an open layout.
The 34 apartments and two penthouses were designed by Sandra Pauquet as an example of unconventional luxury. With nine different floor plans divided into three categories – the “Kategorkis” – the apartments span four floors.
The Kategorkis 1 and 2B face the street, are particularly spacious, and offer separate kitchens, dining rooms, and balconies where guests can observe life along Weinbergsweg.
The other apartments face the tranquil courtyard, while the penthouse suites on the fifth floor combine modern luxury with Parisian sophistication, embodying true Berlin flair.
A unique tribute to the building's past residents is the individual design of the apartments: instead of traditional room numbers, they bear the names of fictional personalities like “Lea Grün,” “Fritz,” or “Herr Günther”, engraved on the keys. Guests reside under a pseudonym, allowing them to remain anonymous and undisturbed if desired. Equipped with a doorbell and mailbox, each apartment feels like a second home while offering the comforts of a luxury hotel, including concierge service and daily cleaning.

FAQ
What makes Gorki Apartments different from a hotel?
Gorki Apartments offer individually designed serviced apartments that combine the privacy of your own home with the comfort of a boutique hotel. The apartments are significantly more spacious than traditional hotel rooms and are ideal for both short and long stays.
Where are Gorki Apartments located in Berlin?
Gorki Apartments are located in Berlin Mitte on Weinbergsweg, close to Rosenthaler Platz. All apartments are situated in the same charming historic building from the Gründerzeit era. The neighborhood is filled with cafés, restaurants, galleries, and small boutiques, while still offering a calm and relaxed atmosphere. Weinbergspark is just a few steps away.
Is the location central and well connected?
Yes, many sights such as Hackesche Höfe and Museum Island are within walking distance. Public transport connections (tram and U-Bahn at Rosenthaler Platz) are excellent, making it easy to explore all of Berlin.
Can I stay for just one night?
Yes, of course. The only exception are the penthouses, which require a minimum stay of two nights.
Can I check in and out at any time?
Our reception is available around the clock. Regular check-in is from 3:00 PM, and check-out is until 12:00 PM. Early check-in or late check-out is possible subject to availability and for an extra fee.
Is there a housekeeping service?
Yes, just like in a hotel, the apartments are cleaned daily by our housekeeping team.
Is parking available and how much does it cost?
We offer a limited number of parking spaces. The underground garage is located between Zehdenicker Straße 10 and 11, about a 3 minute walk from Gorki. The entrance height is 2.10 m. Please contact us prior to arrival so we can reserve a space for you. The cost is €20 per night.
Does every apartment have a bathtub and a shower?
All our apartments have a shower. A bathtub is also available in every apartment except the categories 2C, 3E and Lotte.
Does every apartment have a balcony?
Not every apartment has a balcony. Balconies are available in categories 1 and 2B (on the street side). Our penthouses also offer spacious balconies and rooftop terraces.
Do you have a gym?
We do not have a gym. Every apartment is equipped with a yoga mat. For a small fee, we are happy to provide a Peloton bike in your apartment.
What kitchen appliances are available?
All apartments feature a dishwasher, a Nespresso coffee machine, a kettle, cooking plates, and a refrigerator with freezer compartment. Our penthouses are also equipped with an oven. Upon request, we can provide a microwave, a KitchenAid, and a toaster.
Is there a minibar in the apartments?
Tea, coffee, and water are complimentary. You will also find a selection of organic wines in your apartment. Upon request, we are happy to provide chilled champagne.
Do the apartments have air conditioning?
Our apartments are equipped with Dyson fans. Our two penthouses feature air conditioning.
Are the pillows and duvets filled with down?
No. We only provide down free pillows and duvets in our apartments, making them suitable for guests with allergies or those who prefer non down bedding.
Are there apartments for families?
Yes, we offer special family apartments: Two apartments in category 3 are connected by a connecting door and together provide around 80 m² of space for the whole family.
Is there a baby cot or a high chair?
Yes, upon request, we will provide a baby cot and a high chair free of charge in the apartment.
Are there bicycles at Gorki, and do they cost anything?
Yes, we provide bicycles to our guests free of charge. Simply notify the reception and discover Berlin on two wheels.
May I bring my pet to Gorki?
Dogs are warmly welcome! Please let us know about your four-legged companion before arrival so we can prepare a dog basket and bowls. We charge a fee of €20 per night.
Can I wash my laundry at Gorki?
Yes, we offer a laundry service. It costs €20 per load. We will gladly provide an iron and ironing board upon request.
Is there a breakfast offer?
We send you a selection of the surrounding cafés every morning. You choose your breakfast and we bring it directly to your apartment. Breakfast is not included in the overnight price. Additionally, you can send us a shopping list before your arrival – then we will be happy to stock your fridge for you.
What is the Mustache Gang Rate?
With our Mustache Gang Rate, you save 30% on our standard rate and enjoy flexible cancellation up to 48 hours prior to arrival. To access this offer, you simply need to register. As part of the Mustache Gang, we invite you every day at 5:00 PM to our "Gorki Quality Time" and treat you to a glass of wine or beer at reception.
Who designed the apartments?
The apartments were designed by German-French interior designer Sandra Pauquet in collaboration with Kim Wang.
Do you have other locations?
Yes, we have a sister property in Leipzig with a total of 11 apartments: Cora Apartments.
Can I organize a shoot or event at Gorki?
Yes, shootings or events are possible upon request in all our apartments and penthouses. Please register your plans with us in advance.

Arrival
Private transfer: We will gladly pick you up from the airport and bring you back again. Our partner Prime Limousines has a modern fleet of vehicles with professional and reliable drivers.
Arrival from main station: From Berlin Hauptbahnhof, take tram line M8 at Europaplatz in the direction of Ahrensfelde/Stadtgrenze. Ride for approximately 10 minutes and get off at Rosenthaler Platz. Walk 100 meters along Weinbergsweg, and you will reach your destination. Gorki Apartments are located on the left side of the street. A taxi from Hauptbahnhof to Gorki Apartments typically costs around €16 and takes about 10-15 minutes, depending on traffic.
Arrival from airport Berlin Brandenburg BER: From Terminal 1-2 walk to the S-Bahn station and take the RB14 / RE7 train towards Alexanderplatz or the FEX towards Gesundbrunnen. From Alexanderplatz change to the U8 towards Wittenau. From Gesundbrunnen take the U8 towards Hermannstrasse. Then get off at Rosenthaler Platz (exit Weinbergsweg). After 100 meters on the Weinbergsweg you are at our destination. The Gorki apartments are on the left side of the street. A taxi from the airport costs round about €85.

Meetings and events
Our stylish apartments in the heart of Berlin-Mitte not only provide an exceptional backdrop for photo shoots and film productions but also serve as the perfect location for meetings, workshops, and exclusive events. Conveniently located at Rosenthaler Platz and well-connected via the U8 subway, the Gorki Apartments are easily accessible and centrally situated.
The apartments and penthouses are perfect for showrooms during Press Days, seminars, or private events. Penthouse 1 has previously served as the Dr. Hauschka Beauty Lounge and provided the ideal setting for book launch parties. Our spacious penthouses accommodate flexible seating arrangements for up to 20 people and can be equipped with flip charts and TVs for workshops and presentations.
For smaller meetings of up to 8 people, our Categorki 1, 2B, and 2C apartments—featuring long tables, make an excellent choice.

Photo shoot
Are you looking for an extraordinary film or photo location? The Gorki Apartments offer the perfect backdrop for beauty and fashion shoots, film productions, and creative advertising campaigns.
Our unique apartments are popular settings for exclusive productions: parts of Germany's Next Topmodel were filmed in our stunning Penthouse 1, as well as photo shoots for renowned brands such as Calzedonia, Rosental Organics, and Amex.
Our 34 individually designed apartments and 2 luxurious penthouses provide meticulously crafted spaces for impressive photo shoots and film productions. Whether it’s in the freestanding bathtub with golden feet in Kategorki 2A or on the penthouse rooftop terrace with breathtaking views of the TV Tower and other iconic Berlin landmarks. Every corner tells its own story.
Penthouse 2, with its open and spacious kitchen, served as the perfect setting for a cooking show with Ottolenghi for Brisant.

Looking for a place to settle in while exploring Berlin’s history? Adina Berlin Checkpoint Charlie sits only a few steps from the city’s well‑known former border crossing, giving you an easy base to discover one of Berlin’s most storied neighbourhoods.

Spend your days wandering through impressive architecture, museums and local landmarks, or treat yourself to some shopping at Friedrichstraße, Mitte’s main shopping strip. Ease into the evening with dinner at one of the restaurants at the Gendarmenmarkt before indulging at The Rausch Chocolate House, the largest chocolate house in Europe. If you’re up for a late night out, sip on a cocktail at a bar nearby or visit one of the city’s famous clubs. For those thinking of staying during winter, plan your days around the Berlin Christmas markets and stroll through a selection of stalls filled with unique gifts and cosy food options.

The hotel offers 127 spacious studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom apartments, each designed to help you feel right at home. With a fully equipped kitchen, washing machine and a separate living area, you’ve got everything you need to relax. Take a swim in the heated indoor pool, unwind in the sauna, or stay active with a workout in the gym. Free high‑speed Wi‑Fi and on‑site parking keep things easy, and Berlin‑Brandenburg Airport is around a 40‑minute drive away. Alto Restaurant and Bar is also on hand with modern, comforting dishes.

If you’re travelling for work, light‑filled meeting rooms open to the inner courtyard, with a larger space available for events of up to 80 guests.

Walk to the city’s main sights, including Checkpoint Charlie and Museum Island, soak in its celebrated architecture, and sample authentic German food in nearby markets and restaurants.

Lovers of history will revel in Museum Island, the name given to the northern half of an island in the Spree River, which is home to five incredibly significant museums. Minutes away from the hotel is Gendarmenmarkt, a great place to taste authentic German food, indulge at famous Fassbender & Rausch Chocolatiers or enjoy dinner in one of the first class restaurants frequented by the locals.
Underground stations Stadtmitte and Spittelmarkt are also within easy reach of the hotel, making it easy to explore further afield.
Designed to offer all the comforts of home, this Berlin hotel also boasts an indoor heated swimming pool, sauna, fitness centre and the delicious Alto Restaurant, where you can choose from a selection of meals influenced by local and Australian cuisine.
After a long day enjoying the city’s history, culture, and famous nightlife, return to your spacious serviced apartment at Adina Apartment Hotel Checkpoint Charlie to relax and recharge for tomorrow’s adventures.

Whether you’re here for a few days or a little longer, Adina Berlin Hackescher Markt gives you a comfortable place to land in the middle of Berlin. You’re moments from the Hackesche Höfe and close to well‑loved cultural spots, theatres and historic landmarks including the Brandenburg Gate and the Holocaust Memorial, making this part of the city easy to explore.

The hotel is designed with modern travellers in mind. Choose from 145 spacious studios, one‑bedroom or two‑bedroom apartments, each with a fully equipped kitchen and a separate living area so you’ve got room to settle in. When you feel like taking a break, there’s a sauna and a well‑equipped gym on site.

Berlin‑Brandenburg Airport is around a 45‑minute drive away, and on‑site parking keeps things simple if you’re travelling by car. If you prefer public transport, the Berlin S‑Bahn is a short walk from the hotel and connects you to the rest of the city in minutes.

Spend time wandering Museum Island’s historic collections, or head up the Berlin TV Tower for some of the best views of the city. With art galleries, street art and lively spots to discover at Hackescher Markt, this is an easy, relaxed base to experience Berlin your way.
